artboards.title: States, empty screens, and what moved off

annotations.text:
Staff, redrawn as a dispatch board.
The question the page answers first: who can I hand this to now.
Desktop console at 1440, phone at 390, and the states sheet on the right.

Phone is its own design, not the desktop reflowed:
cards with visible 44px actions, today's register only,
the month behind a door.
